title: MUR SST: multi-scale ultra-high resolution sea surface temperature
description:
JPL MUR-JPL-L4-GLOB-v04.1 daily SST, Zarr V2, consolidated, single level (no multiscales), global 0.01 deg, CF coordinates only (no spatial_ref/CRS array -- lat/lon are plain degree arrays, EPSG:4326 implied). `analysed_sst` is [time, lat, lon], chunks [5, 1799, 3600], int16, scale_factor 0.001, add_offset 298.15, fill -32768, blosc-lz4. Decoded physical range is roughly 271-305 K (-2 to 32 degC); if the browser does NOT apply scale/offset before rendering, the raw int16 values it actually reads span about [-27150, 6850] ((kelvin-298.15)/0.001 over 271-305K) -- the statistics below are declared in those RAW units, and the render rescale matches, since the store itself does not expose decoded values without a CF-aware reader.

License is the store's own non-SPDX text: "These data are available free of charge under data policy of JPL PO.DAAC."; declared "proprietary" with a via link.

Expected browser outcome: draws (ramp on raw analysed_sst values).

analysed_sst.description: Raw int16; decode with scale_factor 0.001, add_offset 298.15 (kelvin) to get physical units. Statistics below are RAW values.
